stops.title: Preparation & Reactions of Alcohols
stops.inShort: Hydroboration-oxidation gives anti-Markovnikov alcohol. Lucas test distinguishes 1°, 2°, 3° alcohols. Tertiary alcohols (e.g. 2-methylpropan-2-ol) resist oxidation under normal conditions.

stops.title: Preparation & Reactions of Phenols
stops.inShort: Cumene process: cumene + O₂ → cumene hydroperoxide --(H⁺)--> phenol + acetone. Phenol + conc. HNO₃/conc. H₂SO₄ → 2,4,6-trinitrophenol (picric acid). Phenol + Zn dust (Δ) → benzene + ZnO.

stops.title: Ethers: Williamson synthesis & Reactions
stops.inShort: Williamson synthesis: R-ONa + R'-X → R-O-R' + NaX (best with 1° alkyl halide). Anisole + HI → phenol + CH₃I. Anisole + Br₂/CH₃COOH → p-bromoanisole (major) + o-bromoanisole.

items.s: R'-X must be 1° alkyl halide to avoid elimination.

board.text: What is the action of: (i) Liquid bromine in acetic acid on anisole (ii) Soda-lime on sodium acetate?
board.answer:
(i) Anisole + Br₂ in CH₃COOH → p-bromoanisole (major) + o-bromoanisole + HBr.
(ii) CH₃COONa + NaOH --(CaO, Δ)--> CH₄ (methane) + Na₂CO₃.

board.text: Write the structural formula and IUPAC name of the alcohol having molecular formula C₄H₁₀O which does not undergo oxidation under normal condition.
board.answer:
Tertiary alcohol does not undergo oxidation under normal conditions.
Structural formula: (CH₃)₃C−OH.
IUPAC name: 2-Methylpropan-2-ol.

board.text: (a) Write the reactions for the action of following reagents on phenol: (i) Nitrating mixture (ii) Zinc dust. (b) What is the action of phosphorous pentachloride on ethyl methyl ether?
board.answer:
(a)(i) Phenol + 3 HNO₃(conc.) --(conc. H₂SO₄)--> 2,4,6-trinitrophenol (picric acid) + 3H₂O.
(ii) C₆H₅OH + Zn --(Δ)--> C₆H₆ (benzene) + ZnO.
(b) C₂H₅−O−CH₃ + PCl₅ --(Δ)--> C₂H₅Cl + CH₃Cl + POCl₃.

board.text: Convert the following: (i) acetaldehyde to isopropyl alcohol (ii) cumene to phenol (iii) anisole to phenol. Write two uses of neon.
board.answer:
(i) CH₃CHO + CH₃MgBr --(dry ether)--> CH₃CH(OMgBr)CH₃ --(H₂O/H⁺)--> CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ (isopropyl alcohol).
(ii) Cumene + O₂ → Cumene hydroperoxide --(dil. H₂SO₄)--> Phenol + Acetone.
(iii) C₆H₅OCH₃ + HI --(373 K)--> C₆H₅OH + CH₃I.
Neon uses: (1) In neon advertising signs/discharge tubes; (2) In beacon lights for pilots.
